name: Makabe Ryuunosuke
source:
A silver craftsman that runs a street stall.

The protagonist meets him by chance in the shopping district.
He appeared around the time strange things started happening around the protagonist.
He doesn't talk much and it's hard to know what he's thinking.
It seems he's hanging around the protagonist in order to find something out.
